description: Documents validate.go and the front end's validate.js must agree on. Each case changes document.json: every set entry puts value at path (object keys and array indexes), removes the key there when it has delete, or, in place of a value, the text its join parts make, where a part is text, or text and how many times to repeat it. A case with an error is refused by both, with an issue at that path, which says the case's message and has the case's code (see codes.go) when it has them; one without is accepted by both. A case with issues is refused with those issues, each with its code, and no others, in any order. Every case has a name of its own, and both sides run every case. Read by TestValidationCorpus and validate.test.js.
